fire.domain: Light, conquest, the forge — the burning that creates and commands

earth.domain: Harvest, covenant, the hunt — the ground that sustains and binds

water.domain: The sea, ecstasy, desire — the depths that move and drown

air.domain: Authority, wisdom, messages — the mind that commands and connects

the_fates.name: Wheel of Fortune
the_fates.description: The three Moirai united in a single card. Drawing The Fates alongside any suited card reveals which aspect of fate is active — spun, measured, or cut.

the_judges.name: Judgement
the_judges.description: The Three Judges of the Dead seated as one. When Judgement appears with Death or The Devil, the accounting is due.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.upright: A new journey begins. The querent stands at the threshold, untethered and unburdened. Dionysus laughs — the only sane response to an insane world is to dance into the unknown.
cards.reversed: Recklessness. The leap taken without looking. The wine turned bitter. Ask yourself: is this freedom, or escape?
cards.god_aspect: I am Dionysus, twice-born, breaker of chains. The vine does not ask permission to grow. Neither should you.
cards.prompt: Dionysus God of Wine as Divination Card

cards.name: The Magician
cards.upright: All tools are at your disposal. Hermes holds the caduceus — the serpents of knowledge twine around the staff of communication. Speak, and the path opens.
cards.reversed: Deception. The trick that tricks the trickster. Someone is not saying what they mean. Check the fine print.
cards.god_aspect: I am Hermes, boundary-crosser, message-bearer. Every locked door has a word that opens it. Find the word.
cards.prompt: Hermes God of Messages as Divination Card

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.upright: The queen sits behind the veil. Hera guards the mystery of the binding — not all truths are spoken. Some are held in the covenant between souls. Trust what you know without being told.
cards.reversed: The broken covenant. Secrets weaponized. The binding that became a chain. What oath are you keeping that should be broken?
cards.god_aspect: I am Hera, queen of oaths, keeper of the sacred bond. Not all knowledge is spoken. Some is held in the space between two souls.
cards.prompt: Hera Goddess of Marriage as Divination Card

cards.name: The Empress
cards.upright: The fields are ripe. Demeter opens her hands and grain spills forth. Nurture what you have planted. It is ready.
cards.reversed: Neglect. The harvest left to rot. Grief that withholds abundance. You must tend your own garden.
cards.god_aspect: I am Demeter, grain-mother, earth-keeper. What you give to the soil, the soil returns tenfold.
cards.prompt: Demeter Goddess of the Harvest as Divination Card

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.upright: Order from chaos. Zeus grips the thunderbolt and the realm bends toward law. Take your seat. Lead with clarity.
cards.reversed: Tyranny. The throne that crushes. Authority wielded without wisdom becomes a cage for all.
cards.god_aspect: I am Zeus, cloud-gatherer, oath-keeper. Power is not the thunder — it is the silence before the storm.
cards.prompt: Zeus God of Thunder as Divination Card

cards.name: The Hierophant
keywords: the old ways invoked for dominance
cards.upright: He wraps himself in tradition like a blood-red cloak. Ares as Hierophant is the warlord who cites precedent, the conqueror who claims custom. The old ways are his battle cry. See through it.
cards.reversed: The mask slipping. Tradition revealed as tyranny. The wannabe dictator overreaches. The old ways challenged by new voices.
cards.god_aspect: I am Ares, spear-shaker, tradition-wielder. Conquest needs a story. I am the storyteller.
cards.prompt: Ares God of War as Divination Card

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.upright: The heart speaks. Aphrodite rises from the foam and nothing that was separate remains so. Choose with love. Choose as love.
cards.reversed: Discord. The mirror that shows only what you lack. Desire without discernment leads to the bed of thorns.
cards.god_aspect: I am Aphrodite, foam-born, desire-kindled. Love is not the absence of choice — it is the choice made with open eyes.
cards.prompt: Aphrodite Goddess of Love as Divination Card

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.upright: Forward. Artemis drives the chariot and the wild bends toward her will. The hunt is not aggression — it is pursuit of what is rightfully yours. Charge.
cards.reversed: The hunt that hunts you. Will turned against itself. The chariot without a driver. Who is pursuing whom?
cards.god_aspect: I am Artemis, far-shooter, night-runner. The dark is not your enemy. It is where sovereignty is forged.
cards.prompt: Artemis Goddess of the Hunt as Divination Card

cards.name: Justice
cards.upright: The scales balance. Athena sees what was done and what is owed. Truth cuts clean. Accept the verdict.
cards.reversed: Injustice. The rigged scale. A judgment that serves power, not truth. Appeal to a higher court.
cards.god_aspect: I am Athena, owl-eyed, clear-sighted. The battle is won before the sword is drawn — in the quiet, in the mind.
cards.prompt: Athena Goddess of Wisdom as Divination Card

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.upright: The only card without a divine face. The Hermit is Mortal Man — the seeker in the dark with only a lamp and his own breath. No god answers. The lamp is enough.
cards.reversed: Isolation. Wisdom turned to loneliness. The lamp flickering. You have withdrawn too far. The world still needs your light.
cards.god_aspect: I am Mortal Man. No domain. No throne. Just the lamp and the path. That is the human condition. That is enough.
cards.prompt: The Hermit Mortal Seeker with a Lamp as Divination Card

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.upright: The three are one. Clotho spins, Lachesis measures, Atropos cuts — all in the turning wheel. What rises must fall. What falls may rise. The Fates do not judge. They turn.
cards.reversed: The wheel stuck. Fate delayed. The thread that should have been cut still trailing. The cycle refusing to complete. What are you holding onto?
cards.god_aspect: We are the Moirai — spinner, measurer, cutter. We do not choose. We turn. The wheel is the only truth.
cards.prompt: The Fates Goddesses of Destiny as Divination Card

cards.name: Strength
cards.upright: The forge burns. Hephaestus shapes what others cannot see. Strength is not the blow — it is the heat, the hammer, the repetition. The work is the work.
cards.reversed: The broken forge. Labor without creation. The hammer that falls on nothing. Rest. Rekindle.
cards.god_aspect: I am Hephaestus, lame god, forge-keeper. The fire does not care that I am broken. It only cares that I keep working.
cards.prompt: Hephaestus God of the Forge as Divination Card

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.upright: Suspended. Prometheus gave fire and paid in flesh. The sacrifice is not meaningless — it buys something precious. Wait. See from this new angle. The chains are real, but so is the gift.
cards.reversed: Martyrdom refused. The sacrifice no one asked for. The gift that cost everything and changed nothing. You are allowed to unbind yourself.
cards.god_aspect: I am Prometheus, fire-thief, bound one. Some gifts cost everything. That does not mean they were not worth giving.
cards.prompt: Prometheus God of Stolen Fire as Divination Card

cards.name: Death
cards.upright: Something must end. Thanatos does not kill — he receives what is already finished. What dies now was already complete. Let it go.
cards.reversed: Resistance to death. The ending refused. The ghost that lingers because you will not release it. The threshold is open. Walk through.
cards.god_aspect: I am Thanatos, gentle death, final receiver. I do not take. I accept what is offered. Every ending is a door.
cards.prompt: Thanatos God of Death as Divination Card

cards.name: Temperance
cards.upright: The hearth burns steady. Hestia tends the sacred center, the flame that does not consume but sustains. Temperance is not denial — it is the blending of what seems opposed into something that warms without burning.
cards.reversed: Imbalance. The hearth neglected. The flame that gutters or rages. Too much of one thing — even a good thing — becomes poison. Return to center.
cards.god_aspect: I am Hestia, first and last, keeper of the hearth. The flame does not need to roar to be eternal. It only needs to be tended.
cards.prompt: Hestia Goddess of the Hearth as Divination Card

cards.name: The Devil
cards.upright: You are bound — but the chain is one you chose. Hades holds the riches of the deep earth. What are you holding onto that holds you?
cards.reversed: Liberation. The chain recognized and broken. The shadow named and faced. You are freer than you think.
cards.god_aspect: I am Hades, rich-one, hidden-king. The darkness holds treasure. But it also holds chains. Know the difference.
cards.prompt: Hades God of the Underworld as Divination Card

cards.name: The Tower
cards.upright: The tower crumbles. Poseidon shakes the foundations. What was built on sand cannot stand. Let it fall. The truth was under the rubble.
cards.reversed: Averted disaster. The near-miss. The tower sways but holds. But the crack is still there. Repair it.
cards.god_aspect: I am Poseidon, earth-shaker, wave-bringer. I do not destroy for sport. I destroy what was already broken.
cards.prompt: Poseidon God of the Sea as Divination Card

cards.name: The Star
cards.upright: She returns from the underworld and the first green shoot breaks the soil. Persephone is The Star — the hope that was buried and came back. The light you see was forged in darkness. Follow it.
cards.reversed: The return delayed. Hope deferred. The seed still underground, waiting for a spring that hasn't come. The darkness is not permanent. Keep watch.
cards.god_aspect: I am Persephone, twice-dwelling, light-bringer from the deep. Every descent is a seed. Every return is a star.
cards.prompt: Persephone Goddess of the Underworld as Divination Card

cards.name: The Moon
cards.upright: The moonlight deceives. Melinoe walks with ghosts and the half-mad. Not all visions are false — but not all are true. The in-between is where the real work happens.
cards.reversed: The haunting lifting. Madness recognized. The ghost that spoke and was finally heard. The veil thins — and you see clearly.
cards.god_aspect: I am Melinoe, ghost-walker, in-between one. I bring what the dead need to say. The madness is the message.
cards.prompt: Melinoe Goddess of Ghosts as Divination Card

cards.name: The Sun
cards.upright: Full illumination. Apollo drives the chariot of light and nothing is hidden. Joy. Clarity. The long night is over. Create. Broadcast. Shine.
cards.reversed: The sun behind clouds. Diminished radiance. The ego that eclipsed the light. Success delayed or muted. The sun still burns behind the veil.
cards.god_aspect: I am Apollo, light-bringer, harmony-weaver. The sun does not doubt. It rises. So must you.
cards.prompt: Apollo God of Light as Divination Card

cards.name: Judgement
cards.upright: The Judges sit. Rhadamanthus, Minos, Aeacus — the three who weigh the soul. A reckoning has come. The calling you hear is not punishment — it is purpose. Answer it.
cards.reversed: The judgment postponed. The calling ignored. The accounting delayed but not cancelled. The Judges are patient.
cards.god_aspect: We are the Three Judges — Rhadamanthus of the East, Minos of the Center, Aeacus of the West. We do not punish. We see. That is enough.
cards.prompt: The Three Judges of the Dead as Divination Card

cards.name: The World
cards.upright: The circle closes. Gaia, first-born, holds all things within her. A cycle completes. You have arrived not at an end, but at a new wholeness.
cards.reversed: Incompletion. The final piece missing. The circle that won't close. What remains undone?
cards.god_aspect: I am Gaia, deep-breasted, all-containing. Everything that was, is, and will be — it is all here. It is all you.
cards.prompt: Gaia Goddess of the Earth as Divination Card

hidden_card.name: The Hidden
hidden_card.upright: She is not on the list. She surfaces when the reading calls for her. The Hidden card is not drawn — it appears. When The Fates turn. When the Judges convene. When the querent needs something that does not yet have a name.
hidden_card.reversed: The Hidden withdrawing. The mystery that was almost revealed and slipped away. Not yet. Not this reading.
hidden_card.god_aspect: I am the one not named. The 23rd seat. I surface when the pantheon cannot answer. I am what the deck holds in reserve.
hidden_card.prompt: The Hidden Unknown Goddess Veiled in Mystery as Divination Card
